description: Calculate the total funding cost (or income) for holding a perpetual futures position. Use when user asks "how much funding will I pay holding X days?" or "is funding eating my profit?". Returns: totalFundingUsdt (negative = you pay, positive = you receive), perIntervalUsdt.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined. For inverse, sizeBase is USD contracts and cost figures come out in the base coin.

fundingRate.description: Funding rate per 8h period as fraction, e.g. 0.0001

name: workflow.run_funding_cost
